note: Korean batchim night: the bottom letter of a block only makes 7 sounds (k n t l m p ng). Real goal: read a Korean menu line — 김치, 밥, 물, 맛있다. Cantonese already gave you -k -t -p -m -ng, so you're cheating a bit. 写三遍，念出声。

tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat tone 低平调) three times in a row. Low and flat, not mid like 試 si3.
tasks.script: 事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6 (compare: 試 si3 is mid-level; 事 si6 sits lower)

tasks.title: 90 Day Korean · Batchim (받침) guide · skim the 7 final sounds table only
Read aloud: menu and everyday batchim

lines.translation: kimchi is delicious · 泡菜好吃
the coffee is delicious · 咖啡好喝

tasks.prompt: Say the 7 final sounds with a Cantonese anchor: 악(k) 안(n) 앋(t) 알(l) 암(m) 압(p) 앙(ng) ×2. Write 밥 김치 맛있다 ×3. Then explain in one breath why 옷 ends in t, not s: point, reason, example.
tasks.script: 악 ak (like 粤语 -k), 안 an, 앋 at (like -t), 알 al, 암 am (like 心 sam1), 압 ap (like 十 sap6), 앙 ang. Writing: 밥 밥 밥, 김치 김치 김치, 맛있다 맛있다 맛있다. Explanation: "옷 ends in t. At the bottom of a block, ㅅ is pronounced t, not s. For example, 옷 is ot, but in 맛있다 the ㅅ moves to the next vowel and sounds like s again."

questions.q: How many final (batchim) sounds are there?
questions.explain: Only 7: k n t l m p ng. Many letters share one sound at the bottom.
ㅂ on top = b, ㅂ at the bottom = p → bap, rice/meal.
ㅅ at the bottom = t → ot.

questions.q: ㅇ at the bottom of a block sounds like…
questions.explain: ㅇ is silent on top, ng at the bottom: 방 bang.
ㅁ + ㅜ + ㄹ at the bottom = 물. ㄹ at the bottom = l.
맛있다 masitda = delicious. Outside = 밖, cheap = 싸다.

questions.q: Recap: which one has a puff of air?
questions.explain: ㅋ is aspirated (puff), ㄲ tense, ㄱ plain.
み = mi, the "21" shape with a loop. ま = ma, む = mu.
